in_sanskrit.name: राजेश
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name राजेश (Rājēś) is derived from the Sanskrit word राजानः (rājānḥ), which means 'king'. This name is commonly used in Hindu culture and is believed to bestow royal lineage, power, and authority upon the bearer.

in_hindi.name: राजेश
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name राजेश (Rājēś) in Hindi is derived from the word राजा (rājā), which means 'king'. This name is widely used in India and is believed to signify royalty, power, and authority.

in_tamil.name: ராஜேஷ
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name ராஜேஷ (Rājēṣ) in Tamil is derived from the word ராஜன் (rājan), which means 'king'. This name is popular in Tamil culture and is believed to confer royal lineage, power, and authority upon the bearer.

in_telugu.name: రాజేశ
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name రాజేశ (Rājēś) in Telugu is derived from the words రాజేశ్ (rājēśa) and వర్దేశ్ (vardēśa), which mean 'lord of the king' and 'lord of the universe', respectively. This name is widely used in Telugu culture and is believed to confer royal lineage, power, and authority, as well as the blessings of the universe upon the bearer.

in_marathi.name: राजेश
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Ruler of the Universe
in_marathi.long_meaning: राजेश हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Rājesh is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘rāj,’ which means ‘king’ or ‘ruler.’ This name is a symbol of power, authority, and leadership. It is believed that individuals named Rājesh possess the qualities of a great leader and are destined to rule in various aspects of life.

in_bengali.long_meaning: राजेश একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Rājesh is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘rāj,’ which means ‘king’ or ‘ruler.’ This name is a symbol of power, authority, and leadership.
